messages.author: 04f542a2b0e2d464
messages.subject: Error while computing lincomb
parts:
I have 15 regions (i fact 14 ad 1 national level), and 4 periods of time and I am fitting a hierarchical spatio-temporal model.

The lincomb function seems to bug for a set of data, while it work for another one. here are the errors messages:

*** ERROR *** Lincomb error for section[lincomb.lc66]
*** ERROR *** [time.area] has length 65, but idx=66 (R-style index) is given

All the regions seems to be well defined. Can anyone have an idea of what could be going on?

Thank you

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error while computing lincomb
parts:
the length of that component is 65 but your index in the make.lincomb
has length 66.

its like this

> lc = inla.make.lincomb(x=1)
> r = inla(y~x, data = data.frame(y=0,x=1), lincomb=lc)
> lc = inla.make.lincomb(x=1:10)
> r = inla(y~x, data = data.frame(y=0,x=1), lincomb=lc)


*** ERROR *** Lincomb error for section[lincomb.lc]
*** ERROR *** [x] has length 1, but idx=2 (R-style index) is given
